title: Consolidate tax calculation
instruction: Tax calculation is repeated across cart, estimateOrder and invoiceTotals. Consolidate the rate table, validation and calculation in one shared source module and make all three paths use it, preserving their public exports and result shapes. src/tax.js calculateTax is canonical: US 7%, GB 20%, CA 13%, nearest-cent rounding; reject negative/nonfinite amounts and unknown regions even for exempt orders, and only then return zero for exemptions. The divergent estimate/invoice behavior should be brought into line with this canonical contract; do not otherwise change observable behavior. Add a regression test.
